description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of two language models, “RedWhale (our)” and “QA-2”, categorized by the correctness of their responses, specifically “Correct”, “Partially Correct”, and “Incorrect”. The horizontal axis displays the model names, ordered alphabetically, while the vertical axis represents the percentage of responses, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked with tick labels at intervals of 10. For “RedWhale (our)”, the “Correct” responses are represented by a dark blue bar reaching approximately 95.7%, the “Partially Correct” responses by a medium blue bar reaching approximately 1.4%, and the “Incorrect” responses by a light blue bar reaching approximately 2.9%. For “QA-2”, the “Correct” responses are represented by a dark blue bar reaching approximately 92.9%, the “Partially Correct” responses by a medium blue bar reaching approximately 2.9%, and the “Incorrect” responses by a light blue bar reaching approximately 4.3%. The bars are stacked, with each color representing a different correctness category, and a legend clarifies the color coding. No bars are visually emphasized.
